  • Battery: 1000mAh
  • Wattage Range: 5-25W

  • Activation: Draw-Activated
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 2mL
  • Coil Resistance: Integrated Mesh
  • Airflow: Adjustable
  • Pod Compatibility: OXVA XLIM V3 Top Fill Pods, XLIM V2 Pods (0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, 1.2Ω)
